title: Patriots reportedly promote Zak Kuhr to defensive coordinator following run to Super Bowl while he was interim

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Patriots reportedly promote Zak Kuhr to defensive coordinator following run to Super Bowl while he was interim
sources.description: Kurh joined the Patriots in 2025 as inside linebackers coach. But he was quickly thrust into the role of interim DC when DC Terrell Williams was diagnosed with cancer.
